output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When mintedAmount is very large, the addition of mintedAmount and totalSupply can wrap around due to the function using uint256, causing a permanent loss of funds.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When _value is very large, the subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value can wrap around due to the function using uint256, causing a permanent loss of funds.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When amount is very large, the multiplication amount * sellPrice can wrap around due to the function using uint256, causing a permanent loss of funds.

The setPrices function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When newSellPrice and newBuyPrice are very large, the multiplication and division operations can wrap around due to the function using uint256, causing a permanent loss of funds.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When msg.value is very large, the division msg.value / buyPrice can wrap around due to the function using uint256, causing a permanent loss of funds.
